title: Zephyr: LinkLayer RX/TX pipeline
notes:
2026-08-27 pipeline audit/fix: removed duplicate link-context enqueue side effects from lichen_link_tx()/lichen_link_relay_raw(); lichen_l2 no longer pops/discards an arbitrary frame before sending. Radio L2 is now the single bounded ownership-copy queue. CCA errors now suppress TX per the documented fail-closed contract. Fixed nested-comment compile break in lora_l2.h. RX audit confirmed signature/SCHC validation and replay commit precede net_pkt copy/delivery; net_pkt ownership/error paths are bounded. Validation: lichen_link_tx strict host syntax PASS; tx_queue 26/26 PASS; link_ctx 1/1 PASS; replay 1/1 UBSan PASS; frame 1/1 UBSan PASS; cppcheck PASS (clang-tidy unavailable). Local Zephyr 4.1 nrf52840 ping_l2 smoke progressed through configuration and exposed blocker project-LICHEN-worker6-4eaq: upstream Zephyr lora_driver_api has no lora_cad()/.cad, causing implicit declaration/nonexistent-field compilation failures; full build additionally stops on unrelated global -Wcast-align vs Zephyr headers. Current bead depends on 4eaq and remains open.
2026-08-27 final validation after 4eaq: fixed missing public module/routing include wiring needed by link/L2 targets; aligned stale lichen_sha256 implementation and LoRa identity caller with the canonical fixed-32-byte three-argument header/test API; handled LORA_STATE_COUNT explicitly under strict -Wswitch-enum; corrected net_if_ipv6_addr_add address type from NET_ADDR_PREFERRED (state enum) to NET_ADDR_MANUAL. Strict local Zephyr 4.1/SDK 0.16.8 nRF52840 builds PASS for lichen_link_rx, lichen_link_tx, lora_l2_rx, lora_l2_tx, lichen_l2_rx, lichen_l2_tx objects and for the complete link, L2, and loopback-driver libraries with CAD/CSMA enabled. Host sanitizer regressions PASS: tx_queue 26/26, link_ctx 1/1, replay 1/1, frame 1/1, CSMA 1/1. diff-check PASS. Full ping_l2 image proceeds past all pipeline modules but stops in unrelated active CoAP send_mutex/status-size errors and Monocypher -Wstack-usage; these are outside this bead and do not affect the successfully compiled pipeline libraries. No shared-worktree collision.
close_reason: Complete LinkLayer RX/TX pipeline validated: bounded ownership/backpressure, authenticated replay-safe RX delivery, fail-closed CAD/CSMA TX, correct Zephyr ownership/error paths, focused sanitizer regressions, and strict pipeline library builds pass.
